---
title: "Reciprocity heightens academic performance in elementary school students"
date: "2022-12-01"
description: "Reciprocity between classmates is associated with higher academic performance in Chilean elementary schools."
categories: ["Education", "Social Networks", "Cooperation"]
---

## Research question
How are students' social reciprocity patterns related to academic achievement?

## Published in
Heliyon (Cell Press), 2022.

## Journal link
- [Journal link](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.heliyon.2022.e11916)

## Main contribution
Using data from 855 students in 14 public schools in Chile, we show reciprocity in peer relationships is associated with better grades.

## Reproducibility
- Data sharing: partial (ethics and privacy constraints)
- Code release: in preparation
- Replication package: coming soon

## Storytelling
A core message is that classroom relational structure is part of the learning environment, not only background context.
